QuestInfo.name: Knight's Qualification
QuestInfo.0: The Empress shall open a new path for me. Go talk Cygnus the Empress.
QuestInfo.1: The Empress shall open a new path for me. Go talk Cygnus the Empress.
QuestInfo.2: You have been bestowed the title of Advanced Knight by Cygnus the Empress.

0.0: I'm glad ol' Wiz wasn't here. I would hate to see that poor, powerless librarian hurt himself.
0.1: Yer stronger than ye were when I last saw ye. Those goons didn't stand a chance against ye.
0.2: Take that ol' book to Neinheart. He's getting ants in his pants waitin' for it.\r\n\r\n#e(You will be moved to Ereve after you accept.)#n

yes.0: Thank ye kindly for all ye've done. Now, to Neinheart! I should be gettin' back as well.

no.0: Have ye forgotten yer mission? Then I'll kindly remind ye. Take the book to Ereve, if ye don't mind.
